thesis: 핵심 결론은 대부분 cutoff-valid 20-F·6-K 1차 자료에 직접 연결된다. 고객·ARPAC·ROE·NPL·자본비율·자사주 수치는 정의와 기간이 확인된다. 가장 중요한 증거 한계는 은행형 RF다. 약 46% 증분수익률은 공시 ROIC가 아니라 분기 이익 증가와 자기자본 증가를 결합한 분석 proxy이므로 단독 gate 근거로 과잉해석하면 안 된다. 다만 보고된 ROE 33%, risk-adjusted NIM 12.4%, 주당이익 성장과 함께 보면 높은 재투자 수익성의 방향성은 지지된다.

evidence.claim: Q2 2026 release directly reports 138.9M customers, ARPAC $17.1, risk-adjusted NIM 12.4%, net income $1.061B, ROE 33%, 90+ NPL 6.9%, deposits $45.3B and credit portfolio $39.4B.
Q2 interim statements directly report Brazil CET1 11.9%, Tier 1 13.4%, CAR 15.7%, $1.848B excess capital margin, and Mexico/Colombia capital ratios above local minimums.
The Q2 6-K directly reports 40,659,600 Class A shares repurchased for $500.393M; the ~$12.31 average price is an arithmetic estimate, not a company-reported valuation judgment.
The FY2025 20-F states management concluded internal control over financial reporting was effective at year-end; KPMG audited the annual financial statements.
The FY2025 20-F states David Vélez held 74.3% of combined voting power through Class B shares. This is a governance concentration fact, not evidence of accounting misconduct.

The ~46% incremental earnings/equity figure in RF is an analyst proxy derived from Q2 2025-2026 quarterly net-income and period-end equity changes. It is not reported ROIC and is sensitive to FX/OCI, timing and regulatory-capital composition.
evidence.source: runs/NU/reports/RF.json based on Q2 2025 and Q2 2026 primary filings

counterevidence: The distributable owner-earnings DCF is a harness modeling convention rather than an issuer-reported cash-flow measure.
Managerial metrics are useful but must not replace accounting P&L; Q2 release provides a reconciliation and net income agrees at $1.061B.
90+ NPL rose to 6.9% and Stage 2/3 ECL balances remain material, so current ROE should not be extrapolated without credit-cycle monitoring.
Founder voting control materially weakens minority governance even though it does not currently undermine financial-reporting reliability.
unknowns: Explicit target CET1/CAR and long-run distributable payout ratio by country.
Full-cycle loss-adjusted returns for newer higher-risk cohorts.
Independent quantitative uplift from NuFormer underwriting.
Normalized profitability of Mexico/Colombia after full banking scale.
falsifiers: Future audited/interim filings reveal a restatement, material weakness or metric-definition inconsistency affecting core evidence.
Reported ROE and risk-adjusted NIM deteriorate while the RF proxy remains high only because of accounting/FX timing effects.
Primary-source values in the frozen pack materially diverge from subsequent source verification for the same cutoff.

key_kpis.name: ROE + risk-adjusted NIM + NPL
key_kpis.threshold: high returns must coexist with stable loss-adjusted credit economics

key_kpis.name: CET1/CAR excess margin
key_kpis.threshold: growth does not consume buffers toward minimums

key_kpis.name: Per-share earnings vs diluted shares
key_kpis.threshold: per-share economics grow without material dilution
